Korean: 우리 가게 메뉴는 뭐든 맛있다구! 마음껏 골라봐!
English: Everything on our menu is delicious! Pick whatever you want!

Korean: 더 이상 진화할 수 있는 스킬이 없다.
English: No more skills can be evolved.

Korean: 배고프면 언제든지 또 오라구! 내가 든든히 먹여줄 테니까!
English: Come back anytime you are hungry! I will make sure you leave full!
Did you enjoy your meal? Please come again next time!

Korean: 짭조름한 간장 맛이 국물에 잘 배었네. 이런 건 결국 기본기가 전부지.
English: The salty soy sauce flavor has soaked nicely into the broth. In the end this kind of dish is all about the basics.

Korean: 겉은 바삭하고 속은 뜨겁네. 방심하면 혀가 먼저 당하겠어.
English: Crisp on the outside and hot inside. Let your guard down and your tongue takes the first hit.

Korean: 진한 돼지뼈 국물이 입 안을 묵직하게 채우네. 배고플 때는 이런 게 정답이지.
English: The rich pork bone broth fills the mouth with weight. When you are hungry this is the right answer.

Korean: 짠맛 뒤에 구수한 단맛이 남네. 이런 국물은 천천히 마셔야 제맛이지.
English: A savory sweetness lingers behind the salt. This kind of broth is best enjoyed slowly.

Korean: 혀는 따가운데 젓가락은 멈추질 않네. 위험한 맛이라는 건 이런 거지.
English: My tongue stings but the chopsticks will not stop. This is what a dangerous flavor tastes like.

English: No skills available for evolution. Obtained {0} EXP instead.
